key_terms.الْمُقَرَّبُونَ: The near [to God], those brought close

ai.seo_question: Who are the Muqarrabun in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'Muqarrabun' are distinguished not merely by general piety but by their profound spiritual proximity to Allah, often exemplified by the Ahl al-Bayt who serve as the ultimate models of this rank. This status reflects a culmination of both innate divine favor (tawqifi) and acquired merit (kasbi), placing them above the 'Sahib al-Yamin' (Companions of the Right) in the hierarchy of Paradise. The term underscores the eschatological reward for those who perfectly align their will with the Divine Will through steadfast faith and righteous action.
